ارتضخنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَخْنَا (irtaḍaḵnā) /ir.ta.dˤax.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اُرْتُضِخْنَا (urtuḍiḵnā) /ur.tu.dˤix.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
